parameters.command: ={{ `PROJECT_PATH='${$json.projectPath}'; if [ ! -d "$PROJECT_PATH" ]; then echo '{"exists":false,"folders":[]}'; exit 0; fi; echo '{"exists":true,"folders":['; FIRST=true; find "$PROJECT_PATH" -mindepth 1 -type d | sort | while read -r dir; do REL=$(echo "$dir" | sed "s|$PROJECT_PATH/||"); DEPTH=$(echo "$REL" | tr '/' '\\n' | wc -l); NAME=$(basename "$dir"); if [ "$FIRST" = true ]; then FIRST=false; else echo ','; fi; echo "{\\"path\\":\\"$REL\\",\\"name\\":\\"$NAME\\",\\"depth\\":$DEPTH}"; done; echo ']}';` }}
